title: Niezawodowa rodzina zastępcza, mama prowadząca działalność: zasiłek macierzyński 20 tygodni na warunkach urlopu macierzyńskiego + 32 tygodnie rodzicielskiego
extractionNotes: Closing note: maternity benefit established and paid. The ZUS register shows the benefit-recipient title (1240) and the health-only self-employment variant for 2024-01-15..2025-01-12, i.e. the whole 52-week period; before that the self-employed title (0510) with voluntary sickness insurance from 2023-01-01 (earlier rows cut off) to 2024-01-14. The ZUR (first parental part, non-professional foster family ticked) gives 15.01.24 - 3.06.24 - 12.01.25, read as 140 days of leave on maternity terms 2024-01-15..2024-06-02 and 224 days of parental leave 2024-06-03..2025-01-12; the split is the claim. Placement: a court order from 2023 amended to place the child in the foster family for the duration of the proceedings, and the foster-care organiser's certificate from January 2024; the placement date is redacted, so takenIntoCareOn is inferred as the first benefit day. The organiser's certificate lists more than one child placed; ages and dates are redacted, and only the child the claim relates to is modelled. A concurrent mandate contract (health insurance only) ran 2024-09-01..2025-03-31. Rate not printed; declared bases not in the file. asOf inferred as the placement date (application date illegible).
